06:25 PDT. THREE of six leaves now closed: 8ce5 (cream-capitate-snake), f9b9 (yogic-soapstone-takin), 0880 (floaty-imperfect-pomeranian).

0880: re-review after two more plan fixes came back PASS and signed -- certified. Its change 2507 was already LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1 and I never amended it, so the close was legitimate. The two fixes the reviewer forced were both real: (1) the join key was never stated, and (2) three of the four rework signals I had cited (revert_recovery, reopen_recovery, first_pass_rate) return REPO-WIDE scalars and cannot be joined per ticket at all -- the implementation had always used caused_by fan-in plus gate rounds, so the plan had been describing signals the code could not consume. Also had to trim the description back under the 8,000-char admission cap after the edit pushed it to 8,004.

9ca8: the completion verifier refused the close on AC7/AC8 and was RIGHT. I had ticked both against a test that drives evaluate() with a synthetic lock key -- that proves the admission RULE but never exercises marker HARVESTING off a real tree, so NEITHER non-def-line placement had any coverage.

Writing the two tests found a REAL BUG. parse_marker used split(None, 2), assuming the mechanism NAME is one whitespace-free token. A workflow step is named for its `- name:` text, or its `run:` snippet when unnamed, so its name routinely contains spaces (".../x.yml::seeded step", ".../x.yml::pytest -q tests"). Its marker harvested under a TRUNCATED key, so the step stayed unjustified. Net: the YAML-step kind -- 226 of the 257 ci_gate entries -- could NEVER be justified by the marker idiom the gate itself tells you to use.

Fix: the reason now starts at the first separator with whitespace on BOTH sides; "::" inside a name is untouched (no whitespace). Extracted _split_name_reason, keeping the old two-token reading with its leading-separator strip as the no-separator fallback, so a blank reason is still an error. AC8's test seen RED against the old parser with the truncation printed in the failure, GREEN after. Mutation-tested: removing the head-window bound kills the AC7 test; dropping the separator's required trailing whitespace kills the flag-name test -- I ADDED that third case because the first two survived that mutant. 31/31 in the file, live ratchet unchanged (active=681 new=0), lint + typecheck + complexity green, zero regression risk (no live markers in tree; all ten hits are docs/templates).

Committed by AMENDING 2510 (Change-Id preserved, now 5dc351813035).

BLOCKED ON INFRASTRUCTURE, NOT ON WORK. Gerrit has been down since ~03:15: first connection refused (http=000), briefly 504, then SSL connection timeouts, now 000 again. Twelve push attempts over ~90 minutes all failed. DNS resolves and TCP 443 is open, so it is up at the socket and not serving. Consequences:
  * The amended 2510 is committed LOCALLY but NOT PUSHED. 9ca8 therefore CANNOT be closed yet: AGENTS.md forbids closing a ticket before its change is Verified +1, and amending invalidated the +1 that patchset 3 held.
  * Vote state for 2505 (b0ac) and 2506 (15f2) is UNKNOWN -- last seen at patchset 4 awaiting CI. Those two cannot be closed until I can read their votes.
  * Nothing can be submitted.
I am running the full local tier meanwhile so the amended 2510 carries local evidence when CI can finally see it.
